turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I suppose, Your Majesty, that you have brought me here today because you require my assistance in unraveling some tangled threads that imperil the House of Ormstein?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I...I fear that my position as the King of Bohemia is under threat, and I require your expertise to uncover the truth behind a series of events that could have far-reaching consequences for the continent.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: May I ask, Your Majesty, what specific events are you referring to, and how do they threaten your position?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have reason to believe that my brother, the Hereditary Prince, is involved in a plot to usurp the throne, and I fear that I am being manipulated by those who seek to exploit this situation for their own gain.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I perceive that you are not merely concerned with the preservation of your throne, Your Majesty, but also with the broader implications of your brother's alleged treachery on the balance of power in Europe.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that the thought of being deposed is a prospect that fills me with great trepidation, and I fear for the future of my kingdom and the stability of the continent.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist that you provide me with more specific details regarding the plot and the individuals involved. Time is of the essence, as I suspect that the situation is more complex and nuanced than a simple case of sibling rivalry.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Can I be of assistance in taking notes, Your Majesty? It may help to clarify your thoughts and provide a clear record of our conversation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must be cautious, gentlemen, for the eyes and ears of those who seek to do me harm may be upon us even now, and I dare not reveal too much of my suspicions lest I inadvertently tip them off to our conversation.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: May I suggest, Your Majesty, that we proceed with the utmost caution, but also with a clear and thorough understanding of the situation, in order to uncover the truth and bring it to light?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist on knowing more about the nature of the plot and the specific individuals involved, Your Majesty. The details you have shared so far suggest a level of complexity that requires a more thorough understanding.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that the very thought of revealing more about this matter weighs heavily upon my conscience, and yet, I fear that I have no choice but to trust in your singular abilities, and your discretion, to unravel the tangled threads of this most delicate and potentially disastrous situation.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that the gravity of the situation is beginning to unfold before us, and I am all the more intrigued by the prospect of unraveling its intricacies.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that my reputation, not to mention the security of my kingdom, hangs precariously in the balance, and I beseech you, gentlemen, to exercise the utmost care and vigilance in this matter.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist on knowing the identity of the woman involved in this plot, Your Majesty. Her connection to you and the potential consequences of her actions are crucial to unraveling the mystery.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: With all due respect, gentlemen, I fear that revealing the identity of the woman at the center of this plot would be to invite disaster, and I must implore you to consider the far-reaching consequences of such an action.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must press you, Your Majesty, to reconsider your reluctance to reveal the identity of the woman involved. Her actions, as you've described them, suggest a level of cunning and determination that cannot be ignored. Might I suggest that her role in this plot is not merely a trivial one, but rather a key to unlocking the entire mystery?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I am torn between the necessity of concealing the woman's identity and the risk of withholding crucial information from those who might aid me. The consequences of failure weigh heavily upon me, and I implore you to understand my position.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must inform you, Your Majesty, that your hesitation is only serving to heighten my suspicions. The more you conceal, the more I am convinced that the key to this mystery lies not with the woman, but with the motivations and actions of those closest to you.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, while I understand the gravity of the situation, I must emphasize that the truth, once revealed, will not be so easily concealed. The threads of this mystery are already beginning to unravel, and it may be more beneficial to shed light on the woman's identity than to continue shrouding it in secrecy.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
